title: cleomella arborea
intro: Cleomella arborea, commonly known as the tree poppy or Cleome, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Cleomaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Cleomella arborea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. Additionally, the plant's extracts have been found to possess antibacterial and antifungal properties, making it a potential candidate for the development of new medicines and treatments.
